G.A. 
 Court No. - 12
 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.479 of 2024, under Section 376, 504, 506, 406
Ipc, Police Station Pure Kalandar, District Ayodhya.

3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that for the last 6 to 7 years, on the false pretext of marriage,
physical relations were made in between the parties and later on, she revealed the name of the applicant.
Similar statement was given in the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
The victim is aged about 22 years.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the nature of allegations and the fact that the relationship is continued over a span of 6 to 7 years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 27.10.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Dost Mohammad be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
